Container.Name: farmstand
Container.Overview: Self-hosted online shop for small makers and farm stands: weekly pre-order drops with pickup times, a walk-up QR farmstand page, Stripe / Venmo / PayPal payments, customer list, and n8n notifications (email and SMS via SMS Gate). After install, open the Web UI and follow /setup; most settings can then be changed in Admin → Settings.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL 16 database (e.g. the postgresql16 app from Community Apps).

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Create a database and user named farmstand in your Postgres container, then fill in its password, IP and port. Use letters and numbers only in the password. Tables are created automatically on first start.

Config.Name: Auth Secret
Config.Description: Required. Any long random string (40+ characters), e.g. from: openssl rand -base64 32. Keep it the same between updates or everyone gets signed out.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people use to reach the site, e.g. your Cloudflare Tunnel domain. While testing at home use http://SERVER-IP:PORT. Used in sign-in links.

Config.Name: Uploads Storage
Config.Description: Where uploaded product photos, logos and icons are stored.

Config.Name: SMTP Server
Config.Description: Outgoing mail server for sign-in links, e.g. smtp.gmail.com or smtp.zoho.com. Optional here; you can set it in Admin → Settings → Email instead.

Config.Name: SMTP Username
Config.Description: Full email address that sends the sign-in links.

Config.Name: SMTP App Password
Config.Description: An app password from your email provider (not your normal password).

Config.Name: Email From
Config.Description: Sender shown on emails, e.g. Your Shop <you@example.com>. Defaults to the SMTP username.

Config.Name: n8n Webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional. Base URL of your n8n webhooks, e.g. http://SERVER-IP:5678/webhook. n8n sends order emails and texts; SMS goes through SMS Gate, configured inside the sample n8n workflow (n8n/order-notifications-workflow.json), not in this app.

Config.Name: n8n Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Optional shared secret sent to n8n in the x-webhook-secret header.

Config.Name: Stripe Secret Key
Config.Description: Optional (card payments). Easier to set in Admin → Settings → Payments.

Config.Name: Stripe Publishable Key
Config.Description: Optional (card payments). Easier to set in Admin → Settings → Payments.

Config.Name: Stripe Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Optional (card payments). Easier to set in Admin → Settings → Payments.

Config.Name: Trust Host
Config.Description: Leave true (needed behind Cloudflare Tunnel or a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns uploaded files (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns uploaded files (100 = users on Unraid).
